statement: At the pinned Linux revision, HID Microsoft defines Xbox model 1797 Bluetooth products 0x0b05 and 0x0b22 and matches both with HID_BLUETOOTH_DEVICE and its FF quirk. This is a Bluetooth HID route, not USB xpad or wireless-receiver GIP. Actual binding still depends on bus identity, driver availability, descriptors and any out-of-tree overrides.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: hid-ids.h:1056-1060 and hid-microsoft.c:275-350, 427-435; optional generic HID fallback described in prior Series consumer research.
